name: Harem Ruin
source:
The game is an adaptation of the original novel Harem Ruin by the author いに, which was published on Ci-en. The link to the prologue of the original novel is: https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/1029/article/10703.

The story follows an ordinary man named Ragba, who, by accident, discovers a demon ruin. Inside the ruin, he finds a mind control device and uses it to brainwash the sage, the hero Iris, and Anima. He then embarks on an ambitious plan to secretly seize control of the entire kingdom and turn all the women of the kingdom into his harem.
translation:
该游戏改编自いに作者的原著小说《后宫废墟》，已在慈恩上发表。原著小说序言链接为：https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/1029/article/10703。

故事讲述了一个名叫拉格巴的普通人，偶然发现了一个恶魔遗迹。在废墟中，他发现了一个精神控制装置，并用它对贤者、英雄艾里斯和阿尼玛进行了洗脑。然后他开始了一项雄心勃勃的计划，秘密夺取整个王国的控制权，并将王国所有的女人都变成他的后宫。
